newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austrian rail and Verbund brace for telecom war.
newsitem.headline: Austrian rail and Verbund brace for telecom war.

text.p: Austria's national railway OeBB and national grid company Verbund on Wednesday laid down the foundations to build a telecommunications network that would rival the existing monopoly of the postal system.

The Alpine republic's telecoms industry will be liberalised in January 1998 and to this end Oesterreichische Bundesbahn and Verbund will merge the networks they already have in operation for in-house purposes into a mutual subsidiary tele.ring, the companies said in a statement.

OeBB and Verbund currently operate a total 7,700 kilometres (4,774 miles) of data cables from 1,700 locations and are open to talks with interested parties both domestic and foreign. -- Vienna newsroom, +431 531 12 253
